name: attn-mla-glm5
note: MLA attention block (GLM-5.2 style): hidden 6144, 64 heads, q_lora_rank 2048, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_head_dim 256 (192 nope + 64 rope), v_head_dim 256. Models the low-rank query path (q_a 6144->2048, q_b 2048->64*256=16384) then attention and o_proj from 64*256=16384. KV latent path omitted (same linear-chain limitation as deepseek example).
